name: storage-v1
description: Storage RMA validation. SSD-only workload: max controller throughput first, then sustained read endurance, then burst recovery testing. No CPU, GPU, or RAM stress.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 15s idle baseline. SMART health captured at run start.

phases.name: full-load
phases.notes: 5 min SSD kill test. Max read throughput only. Dead or failing NVMe shows errors fast without CPU/GPU/RAM load confounders.

phases.name: sustained-read
phases.notes: 20 min sustained SSD read endurance. Catches thermal throttling, firmware bugs, and bad blocks under continuous storage load.

phases.name: burst
phases.notes: 10 min storage pulse on/off. Controller recovery under intermittent load. Catches marginal thermals and firmware/cache recovery bugs.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.notes: 3 min cooldown. SMART health captured at run end, compared to pre-run.
